title: hemionitis eriophora
intro: Hemionitis eriophora, commonly known as the "chain fern", is a type of plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis eriophora include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antibacterial properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and prevent the growth of bacteria. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
